fields.title: Abasajja Abaanyeenya Eggulu
fields.description: Wali weebuuzizza engeri abasajja gye baakyusaamu ebyafaayo by’ensi nga tebalina bugagga bwa ku nsi wadde obuyinza bw’ensi? Ekitabo kino kibikkula ekyama kyabwe: yingini y’okusaba. Okuva ku “kisenge kya bboyila” ekya Spurgeon okutuuka ku byamagero bya George Müller, laba engeri abalwanyi bano gye baanyeenyaamu omukono gwa Katonda. Bw’oba olumwa enjala y’okukkiriza okusukka ku ngulu, leka abazira bano bakuyigirize obukugu bw’okwegayirira.
fields.hook: Spurgeon, Müller, Hudson Taylor: ebyaliwo abasajja aba bulijjo bwe baasaba ddala.

qa.question: Ekitabo “Abasajja Abaanyeenya Eggulu” kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kiraga engeri abasajja gye baakyusaamu ebyafaayo by’ensi si lwa bugagga bwa ku nsi oba obuyinza bw’ensi, wabula lwa kusaba — yingini ekwese eyali emabega w’obuyinza bwabwe. Okuva ku “kisenge kya bboyila” ekya Spurgeon, ab’omu kkanisa mwe baasabiranga, okutuuka ku maka g’abaana bamulekwa aga George Müller agaalabirirwanga lwa kusaba kwokka, ekitabo kikuŋŋaanya ebyokulabirako by’abeegayirizi abaanyeenya omukono gwa Katonda, era kiyita omusomi mu kukkiriza okusukka ku ngulu ne kutuuka mu kusaba okwa ddala.

qa.question: Ensonga enkulu ey’ekitabo kino y’eriwa?
qa.answer: Nti amaanyi aga ddala agali emabega w’obulamu obwabumba ebyafaayo kwe kwegayirira, so si birungi bya buzaale — nti abasajja bano “baanyeenya eggulu” olw’okusaba, bwe batyo ne balaba Katonda ng’akola ku nsi. Ekitabo kikubiriza omusomi okulaba okusaba ng’amaanyi ga ddala agakwata ku Katonda, n’okulekera awo okupima omugaso gw’omuntu mu by’omwoyo ng’atunuulira ebintu ebirabika mu kifo ky’okwegayirira okw’ekyama.

qa.question: “Ekisenge kya bboyila” ekya Spurgeon kye kiruwa?
qa.answer: Kitegeeza emboozi emanyiddwa ennyo eya Charles Spurgeon ng’alaga abagenyi ensibuko y’amaanyi g’obuweereza bwe — ekisenge wansi wa kkanisa ye ennene e London, ab’omu kkanisa mwe baakuŋŋaaniranga okusaba ng’okusinza kugenda mu maaso. Yakiyita “ekisenge kya bboyila” eky’ekkanisa, yingini ekwese eyabugumyanga byonna ebyali waggulu. Ekitabo kikikozesa ng’akabonero akalaga nti okusaba, so si kubuulira kwokka, kwe kuvuga amaanyi ag’omwoyo aga ddala.

qa.question: George Müller alabikira atya mu kitabo kino?
qa.answer: Ng’ekyokulabirako ekisingira ddala eky’okusaba okunyeenya omukono gwa Katonda mu kugaba ebyetaagisa ebirabika. Müller yalabirira abaana bamulekwa enkumi n’enkumi e Bristol nga tasabangako muntu yenna buyambi okuggyako Katonda, era yalaba ebyetaago ebimu ku bimu nga bimalibwa emirundi mingi ng’ayita mu kusaba. Ekitabo kimulaga ng’obujulizi nti okwegayirira kutuukiriza ebyo eby’obugagga bw’abantu bye bitasobola.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Buli Mukristaayo alumwa enjala y’okukkiriza okuzito era okw’amaanyi, era eyeebuuza engeri abantu aba bulijjo gye bakyusizzaamu ebyafaayo ku lwa Katonda. Kyawandiikibwa okuyigiriza omusomi obukugu bw’okwegayirira ng’ayita mu kyokulabirako ky’abo abaakukola, era kyogera naddala eri abo abawulira nga tebalina bisobozi oba maanyi kuleeta njawulo.

qa.question: Ekitabo kigamba nti “ekyama” ky’abasajja bano kyali ki?
qa.answer: Yingini y’okusaba. Nga tebalina bugagga wadde obuyinza bw’ensi, kye baali bafaanaganya kwe kwali obulamu bw’okwegayirira okutakoowa era okw’okukkiriza, era okuyita mu ekyo — so si mu bifo bye baalimu oba mu busobozi bwabwe — kwe baakyusiza ebigwawo ne balaba Katonda ng’akola. Ensonga y’ekitabo yonna eri nti ekyama kino kiggulirwawo buli mukkiriza anaasaba.

qa.question: Kikwatagana kitya ne “Abasajja b’Okusaba” ne “Abakazi Abaanyeenya Eggulu”?
qa.answer: Bye bitabo ebigenderako ebikwata ku kukkiriza kumu — nti ebyafaayo bikyukira ku kusaba. “Abasajja Abaanyeenya Eggulu” ne “Abasajja b’Okusaba” byombi bikuŋŋaanya abasajja abaasaba, ate “Abakazi Abaanyeenya Eggulu” kiraga abakazi abaasaba; byonna awamu bikubiriza okuva ku buli ludda amazima nti Katonda abumba ensi ng’ayita mu kwegayirira kw’abantu abeetoowaze.

qa.question: Omusomi asaana kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, oba ku bulamu bwonna obumusikiriza, kubanga buli bumu buyimirira bwokka — naye ekitabo kigendereddwamu okuzimba okukkiriza mpolampola okutuuka ku kuyitibwa okusaba. Bwe bisomebwa n’okusaba, ebyokulabirako bya Spurgeon, Müller n’abalala tebigendereddwamu kumanyisa bumanyisa, wabula okusindika omusomi ku maviivi.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Ekyama ky’Abo Abaanyeenya Ensi
fields.body_html:
Waliwo amaanyi amagye gonna ge gatayinza kukola, gavumenti yonna gy’etayinza kuteekako tteeka, era ekibiina kyonna kye kitayinza kuzaala. Tegayinza kuteekebwa mu ccupa, kusibibwa mu bipapula, wadde okugulibwa. Tegalina kitongole kya kwerangirira, era tegaleekaana nga tegannatuuka. Kyokka bwe gakka, amawanga gakankana, emitima emikakanyavu ne gimenyeka ne gigguka, n’ebitasoboka ne bisaanuuka ng’olufu olw’oku makya. Amaanyi gano kwe kuddibwamu kw’okusaba — Katonda omulamu ng’addamu butereevu, mu bwennyini, era mu bufuzi bwe, okukaaba kw’abantu be.

Era abasajja abali mu kitabo kino baali bayize, buli omu mu ngeri ye, engeri y’okugakwatako.

Empapula z’ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa zijjudde okuddibwamu kw’okusaba okw’ekitalo, naye tekwajjira bwereere. Kwali kibala ky’abasajja n’abakazi abaakwata Katonda ku kigambo kye bwe yalangirira nti: “Mumpite n’abayitaba ne mbalaga ebikulu ebitanoonyezeka bye mutamanyi” (Yeremiya 33:3). Olunyiriri olwo si kuyita kwa mpisa obuyisi okwa katonda atassaayo mwoyo. Kye kisuubizo eky’obuvumu eky’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna — okuyita okw’olwatu, okwalangirirwa okuyita mu byasa, eri buli mmeeme eyagala okusembera. Abasajja abali mu kitabo kino baawulira okuyita okwo ne bakuddamu n’obulamu bwabwe.

Omulwanyi mu kusaba y’ani? Si muntu bumuntu asaba n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka oba ng’alaga enneewulira ennyo, newakubadde ng’ebyo byombi biyinza okubaawo. Omulwanyi mu kusaba y’oyo azudde nti okusaba si kwogera kwa muntu omu okusindikibwa waggulu mu kasirise akatafaayo, wabula mboozi ya ddala ne Katonda afaayo ennyo, mu bwennyini era mu bufuzi bwe, ku nsonga z’abaana be. Y’oyo akoze okuwanyisiganya okukulu — ng’awaayo okwetawaana n’okweraliikirira, n’afuna emirembe Pawulo gy’annyonnyola: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:6–7).

Azudde nti ebbanga eriri wakati w’amaviivi ge n’ettaka, mu mazima, lye bbanga erisinga okubala ebibala mu bitonde byonna.

Abasajja bano ekkumi baava mu byasa eby’enjawulo, mu ssemazinga ez’enjawulo, n’empisa ez’enjawulo, n’ennono ez’enjigiriza ez’enjawulo. Omu yali mubuulizi ow’eddoboozi ery’okubwatuka ow’omu mulembe gwa Victoria, eyajjuzanga ekizimbe ekisinga obunene mu London. Omulala yali muminsani muvubuka omunafu eyali afa akafuba mu nsiko z’Amerika.

Omu yali mutabani w’omusimi w’amanda ow’e Wales, eyasaba okuyita mu biseera ebikulu ebyakyusa Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna.

Omulala yali mulenzi w’e Yorkshire eyeesiga Katonda okuliisa bamulekwa enkumi bbiri nga tasabyeko bantu wadde essente emu. Ekyabagatta tekyali mpisa zaabwe wadde enkola zaabwe, wabula okukakasa kwabwe okujjuvu era okutanyeenyezeka nti okusaba tekwali kyongerezo ku mulimu gw’Obwakabaka — kwe kwali omulimu gwennyini. Ebirala byonna byali bibala byakwo.

Yesu yennyini ye yateekawo ekyokulabirako ky’okukakasa kuno. Yagerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agenderera okubalaga nga bwe “bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo” (Lukka 18:1). Ekigambo ekyo, obutakoowanga, kya kitalo. Si lwe weewulira obwagazi. Si mu biseera by’akabi byokka. Bulijjo. Omulwanyi mu kusaba ekiragiro kino akitwala nga kikulu, n’akiddamu n’enkola y’obulamu mwe okusaba kutali kasenge kamu, wabula mpewo — embeera ebuna wonna obulamu bwonna mwe bukolerwa. Nga Pawulo bwe yakifunza mu bigambo bibiri: “Musabenga obutayosa” (1 Basessaloniika 5:17).

Abasajja bano baasasula omuwendo olw’okusaba kwabwe. Baasasula mu tulo, mu kwesiima, mu linnya lyabwe, era oluusi mu bulamu bwabwe. John Hyde yeemalamu amaanyi mu biro ebiwanvu eby’okwegayiririra ng’akaaba amaziga; mikwano gye baayogera ku musawo eyasanga omutima gwe nga guvudde mu kifo kyagwo mu kifuba, era baakkiriza nti obuzito bw’okusaba bwe bwali bukikoze. David Brainerd yamala ennaku nnyingi nga yeevuunise ku ttaka ery’obunnyogovu mu bibira by’e New Jersey, ng’anafuye nnyo okuyimirira, naye ng’azitoowereddwa nnyo okulekera awo okusaba. E. M. Bounds yazuukukanga ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro buli lunaku okumala emyaka amakumi abiri egy’enkomerero y’obulamu bwe, ng’awa Katonda essaawa ezisooka eza buli lunaku nga tannawa muntu mulala yenna ezisigadde. Rees Howells n’abayizi be oluusi baasabanga ekiro kyonna mu myezi egyasinga enzikiza mu Lutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri. Bano tebaali basajja ba kwesanyusa n’okwewummuliza. Baali balwanyi.

Kyokka obujulirwa bwabwe, bonna awatali kulekayo n’omu, bwali nti omuwendo gwe baasasula gwali si kintu bw’ogugeraageranya n’empeera. Baali bazudde omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kye yali amanyi: “Mumwesigenga bulijjo mmwe abantu, mumutegeezenga byonna ebiri mu mitima gyammwe, kubanga Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe” (Zabbuli 62:8). Baali bayiye emitima gyabwe mu maaso ge — ne basanga nga Katonda yakwata buli ttondo. Baasaba, ne baweebwa. Baanoonya, ne bazuula.

Baakonkona, ne balaba enzigi nga zigguka, enzigi omukono gw’omuntu gwonna gwe gutandisobodde kunyeenya. Ebigambo bya Yesu byali bya mazima gye bali, nga bwe biri eri buli mulembe ogulina obuvumu okubikkiriza: “Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo. Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo” (Matayo 7:7–8).

Yakobo, bwe yali awandiika ng’aluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, teyali ayogera bya mu bbanga bwe yalangirira nti “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo” (Yakobo 5:16).

Yali alaga ekintu ekya ddala, ekiyinza okukakasibwa, ekintu abasajja abali mu kitabo kino kye baakakasa n’obulamu bwabwe. Okusaba kukola. Si lwa oyo asaba, wabula lwa Oyo addamu.

Essuula zino si byafaayo bya bayivu. Bubaka obukuyita. Bw’onoozisoma, ojja kwesanga ng’oyimiridde emirundi mingi ku mugo gw’obulamu obw’omunda ennyo — obulamu mwe Katonda atali muntu wa kukubira ssimu mu kabenje kyokka, wabula mukwano gw’otambula naye buli lunaku; si y’oddukirako ng’ebirala byonna biremye, wabula gw’osooka okutuukirira. Obulamu obwo bukusobokera. Bwe busika bwa buli mwana wa Katonda eyeetegefu okunoonya Kitaffe n’omutima gwe gwonna.

Obulamu buno ekkumi bukuzuukusemu ekintu ekitukuvu. Bukuleetere obutamatira n’eddiini ennafu, ey’ekyanguyirize, era ey’omukolo obukozi. Bukusindike ku maviivi go n’enjala empya n’okusuubira okuzzibwa obuggya — era osangeyo Katonda y’omu ataggwaawo abasajja bano gwe baasanga ng’abalindiridde.

fields.title: Charles Spurgeon — Omulangira w’Ababuulizi Eyasabanga
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Charles Haddon Spurgeon yazaalibwa nga 19 Juuni 1834, e Kelvedon, Essex, mu Bungereza, nga mutabani era muzzukulu w’abasumba b’amakanisa ga Independent, abaalina etterekero ly’ebitabo by’Abapulitaani eryabumba endowooza ye ku by’eddiini okuva mu buto. Yakyuka ng’alina emyaka kkumi n’etaano mu muyaga ogw’omuzira e Colchester, era yali abuulira mu nnyumba ezijjudde abantu nga tannaweza myaka kkumi na musanvu. Bwe yali wa myaka kkumi na mwenda yali akkirizza okuyitibwa okuweereza mu New Park Street Chapel e London, era mu myaka ebiri ebibiina byali binene nnyo nga poliisi yeetaagibwa okufuga abantu ebweru w’enzigi. Okusaba kwanyeenyanga omukono ogunyeenya ensi, era omukono ogwo buli mukkiriza asobola okugutuukako, singa akozesa okusaba.

fields.title: Andrew Murray — Omusumba Eyayigiriza Ekkanisa Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Andrew Murray yazaalibwa nga 9 Maayi 1828, e Graaff-Reinet, mu South Africa, mutabani w’omusumba w’Ekkanisa ya Dutch Reformed eyazaalibwa e Scotland, eyalina okukkiriza okugumu era okutaliimu bukuusa ng’ensalo y’e Cape gye yali.

Bwe yamala okusomera e Aberdeen ne Utrecht, Murray yaddayo mu South Africa mu 1848 n’atandika obuweereza obwamala emyaka nkaaga egy’ekitalo — okusooka ng’omusumba atambula ku kitundu ekyenkana obunene bwa Bungereza, oluvannyuma ng’omukulembeze w’okuzuukuka okunene okw’e Cape okwa 1860, era ku nkomerero ng’omuwandiisi eyawandiika ebitabo 240 ebyavvuunulwa mu nnimi nnyingi nnyo ne bisomebwa obukadde n’obukadde. Yafa mu 1917 ng’alina emyaka kinaana mu munaana, ng’akyawandiika. Okuzuukuka kwe yalaba era n’ayamba okukulembera e Worcester mu 1860 kwamukakasa obulamu bwe bwonna nti buli kuzuukuka okw’omwoyo okwa ddala kuzaalibwa mu kusaba, era obuweereza bwe obwasigalawo yabuwaayo okuyigiriza Ekkanisa ekitegeeza okusaba n’obuziba, n’obunyiikivu, n’obwetoowaze.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Murray mwe yatandikira mu by’eddiini kyali kya maanyi nga bwe kyali ekyangu: Yesu si ye gwe tusaba yekka, wabula ye Musomesa waffe mu kusaba. Abayigirizwa tebaasaba Yesu kubannyonnyola nkola ya kusaba; baamusaba abayigirize — “Mukama waffe, naawe tuyigirize okusaba” (Lukka 11:1). Baali bamulabye ng’asaba, nga balabye okusaba kwe kye kwavaamu, era baategeera nti kye yakolanga mu kusaba tekwali kwolesa buyinza obw’enjawulo obwa Katonda yekka, wabula kwali kulaga enkolagana gye yali abayita okuyingiramu. Murray yazimba ekitabo kye ekisinga obukulu, “Ne Kristo mu Ssomero ly’Okusaba,” ku musingi guno: omukkiriza tayiga bwiga ku kusaba — atendekebwa Omwana wa Katonda mu kikolwa kyennyini eky’okusaba.

Ekisumuluzo ky’okuyingira essomero lino, nga Murray bwe yayigiriza, kwali kunywerera mu Kristo. Yesu yali akyogedde lwatu era awatali kakwakkulizo: “bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga” (Yokaana 15:7). Kino tekyali kakodyo ka kuwaliriza Katonda; kwali kunnyonnyola nkolagana. Ettabi erinywerera mu muzabbibu terisaba bintu ebitali bya buzaaliranwa bwa muzabbibu — linyuunya ebyo ebiba bikulukuta dda mu muzabbibu, ne libala ebibala omuzabbibu gwennyini bye gwayagala okubala. Murray yayigiriza nti okusaba okutaddibwamu kumpi bulijjo, ku kikolo kyakwo, kubeera kizibu kya kunywerera.

Ekigambo kya Kristo bwe kibeera mu mukkiriza mu bugagga bwakyo, by’asaba byeyongera okulaga omutima gwa Kristo — era ebyo, nga Murray bwe yawandiika, “tebiyinza butaddibwamu.”

Omugugu Murray gwe yalina ku kwegayiririra abalala tegwayawukana ku njigiriza ye ku buvunaanyizibwa bw’Ekkanisa eri ensi. Yakkiriza nti Katonda yateeka Ekkanisa mu mwagaanya wakati wa Katonda omutukuvu n’ensi eyeetaaga, ng’eweereddwa amaanyi Omwoyo okwegayiririra ku lw’abo abatasobola oba abatayagala kwesabira. Yeesigama ku Isaaya 62:6–7 — “Mmwe abakoowoola Mukama temuwummula. Era temumuganya kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi” — ng’ekifaananyi ky’okuyitibwa kw’omwegayirizi: si kutegeeza Katonda byetaago n’oluvannyuma n’ogenda, wabula okunyiikira n’obugumiikiriza obutukuvu okutuusa ekintu lwe kimenyeka mu nsi etalabika. Murray yennyini yasabiranga abantu abatongole, amawanga agatongole, n’embeera ez’omwoyo entongole okumala emyaka — oluusi amakumi g’emyaka — nga talaba kuddibwamu, ng’akkiriza nti omulimu ogutalabika gwali gwa ddala, nga ensi erabika bwe yandigulaze lumu.

Enjigiriza ye ku bwetoowaze n’okusaba y’emu ku birabo bye ebyasinga okwawukana ku by’abalala. Yawandiika ekitabo kyonna ku nsonga eno — ekyatuumibwa obutuumibwa “Obwetoowaze” — ng’agamba nti amalala ge kikolo ky’okulemererwa kwonna okw’omwoyo, era nti tewali kusaba kutuuka ddala eri Katonda awatali kwetoowaza kwa ddala mu maaso ge. Okusaba kw’omuwooza mu Lukka 18:13 — “Katonda, onsaasire, nze omwonoonyi” — tekwali kyakulabirako kya kusaba kwa kukyuka kwokka, wabula kya buli kusaba, buli lunaku. Murray yayigiriza nti omuntu bw’asemberera Katonda nga ku mimwa gye kuliko wadde akatono ak’okwetendereza, okusaba kwe kuba kutandise dda okukka wansi.

Kyokka Murray obukakali buno yabwenkanya n’ebisuubizo ebisinga obugabi. Olw’okuba obutuukirivu bwa Kristo bwe buyimiriza omukkiriza mu maaso ga Kitaffe, omukkiriza eyeetoowazizza yali asobola okujja n’obuvumu obujjuvu: “Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo” (Matayo 7:7). Obwetoowaze tebwakendeeza kusaba — bwakutukuza. Omuntu eyali yeggyeemu okwefuula yali asobola okusaba ebintu ebinene, kubanga yali tasaba mu linnya lye, wabula mu linnya ly’Omwana wa Katonda. Murray yawandiika nti: “Okusaba kw’abeetoowaze kwe kusaba okw’okukkiriza, era okusaba okw’okukkiriza kwe kusaba Katonda kw’addamu.”

Murray era yafaayo nnyo okumala ebbanga ku kye yayita “okusaba kw’Omwoyo” — amazima nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu tayamba buyambi kusaba kw’omuntu, wabula azaala okusaba okw’obwakatonda okuyita mu kibya eky’omuntu. Okukakasa kwa Pawulo nti “Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26) eri Murray kwali kutegeeza nti okwegayiririra okusinga obuziba tekwali kibala kya kufuba kwa mukkiriza okw’omwoyo, wabula kujjula kw’Omwoyo wa Kristo eyali abeera mu ye. Ekiva mu kino mu bulamu kyali kya kusumulula: omukkiriza teyali yeetaaga kwekolera bunyiikivu wadde okwekakaatika amaanyi. Yali yeetaaga kusirika ekimala, okwewaayo ekimala, n’okwegonda ekimala, okwegayiririra kw’Omwoyo yennyini kulyoke kumuyitemu awatali kiziyiza. fields.title: Rees Howells — Omwegayirizi Eyalwana Entalo ku Maviivi Ge
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Rees Howells yazaalibwa nga 10 Okitobba 1879, mu biwonvu by’abasimi b’amanda mu South Wales — nga ye mwana ow’omukaaga mu baana kkumi na mumu ab’amaka g’abakozi aba nonconformist abaali banywevu mu nnono y’amakanisa g’e Wales. Yagenda mu Amerika okumala akaseera katono ng’akyali mu myaka amakumi abiri, n’akolera e Pittsburgh, n’oluvannyuma n’addayo e Wales mu 1904 n’asikirizibwa mu Kuzuukuka kwa Wales okunene — okuzuukuka okwakyusa abantu abasoba mu 100,000 mu bbanga eritawera mwaka gumu. Okusisinkana okw’amaanyi n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu 1906 kwamuyingiza mu bulamu obw’okwegayiririra. Ye ne mukyala we baatandikawo Bible College of Wales e Swansea mu 1924, era mu Lutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri ettendekero eryo lyamanyika mu nsi yonna olw’okwegayiririra okutakoma era okutongole ku lw’Abakago. Howells yafa mu 1950, n’aleka omusika — ogwakuumibwa mu byafaayo bye ebyawandiikibwa Norman Grubb, “Rees Howells: Omwegayirizi” — ogusindise abantu bangi mu kwegayiririra okw’obuziba okusinga oboolyawo ekitabo ekirala kyonna eky’omulembe guno ku kusaba.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Howells yayawula n’obwegendereza era mu ngeri enkulu wakati w’okusaba okwa bulijjo n’okwegayiririra.

Okusaba, bwe yayigiriza, kuyinza okuweebwayo buli mukkiriza mu kiseera kyonna — ng’aleeta ebyetaago mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’alaga okwebaza, ng’asaba ekisa. Okwegayiririra kusinga okuba okw’omuwendo era okutongole: kwe kwagala okuyimirira mu kifo ky’omuntu omulala mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’ositudde omugugu gwe nga gulinga ogugwo, ng’otwala embeera ye ey’omwoyo ku ggwe, era ng’ogaana okugireka okutuusa Katonda lw’akola. Enjawulo eno, eyasibuka mu kyokulabirako kya Kristo yennyini ng’Omwegayirizi Omukulu, eri Howells teyali kirowoozo bulowooza. Gwe gwali omusingi ogwatambuza obulamu bwe bwonna.

Howells enjigiriza eno yagisimba mu Ezeekyeri 22:30, Katonda w’agamba nti: “Ne nnoonya omuntu mu bo ayinza okuzimba ekisenge era ayinza okubeeyimiririra mu maaso gange ku lw’ensi, naye ne siraba n’omu”. Eri Howells, ebigambo bino byannyonnyola obwetaavu obusinga obukulu mu buli mulembe — si nteekateeka nnyingi, oba ebikozesebwa, oba aboogezi abalina ebirabo, wabula abeegayirizi abeetegefu okuyimirira mu mwagaanya ku lw’abalala. Okubulawo kw’abeegayirizi, bwe yakkiriza, kwaleetanga ebivaamu eby’omwoyo butereevu mu nsi erabika. Kino tekyali kya kyama bwa kyama. Eri Howells, kyali kya mugaso nga olutalo olulala lwonna: “Kubanga tetumeggana na mubiri wadde musaayi, wabula tulwanyisa abafuzi, n’ab’obuyinza, n’amaanyi ag’ensi ag’ekizikiza” (Abaefeso 6:12).

Endowooza ey’“okwefaananyiriza” ye yali omutima gw’okwegayiririra kwa Howells. Yayigiriza — era n’akikola buli kiseera — nti omwegayirizi ow’amazima ateekwa okuyingira mu bumanyirivu bw’oyo asabirwa. Kino kyali kitegeeza ekisingawo ennyo ku kuwulira ekisa oba okukwata olukalala. Kyali kitegeeza okwetegekera, wansi w’obulagirizi bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okwetikka ekitundu ku muwendo, obunafu, oba okubulwa kw’oyo asabirwa. Howells yannyonnyola emirundi mingi Katonda gye yamukulembera okuwaayo ssaddaaka entongole ez’ensimbi, okugaba ebintu bye, oba okuyingira mu biseera eby’okusiiba n’okubonaabona kw’omubiri ng’ekyokulabirako ekirabika eky’okwegayiririra kwe ku lw’abantu oba embeera entongole. Ssaddaaka teyali kya kuwanyisiganya — yali bukakafu bwa kwefaananyiriza okw’amazima, ekifo okwegayiririra we kwaviira mu mutwe ne kuyingira mu mutima, ne kuva mu mutima ne kufuuka ekikolwa eky’omuwendo era ekirabika.

Mu Lutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri, Howells n’abayizi ba Bible College of Wales beewaayo okwegayiririra okutakoma ku lw’Abakago, nga basaba buli kawungeezi okuva ku ssaawa emu ey’akawungeezi okutuuka mu ttumbi, era emirundi mingi okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

Baasabanga ku nsonga entongole — era ne bawandiika mu bitabo byabwe eby’okusaba — ku lw’okuggyibwa kw’abaserikale e Dunkirk, Olutalo lwa Bungereza, olutabaalo lw’omu North Africa, n’okugoba kw’amagye ku lubalama ku D-Day.

Ebiwandiiko by’ebitabo ebyo biraga ebiro eby’okusaba okw’ennaku ennyingi n’amaziga, ne biddirirwa okuwulira okw’amangu nti waliwo ekimenyese mu by’omwoyo. Howells yali mukakafu nti ebigambo bya Yesu tebyakwatanga ku nfuga y’ekkanisa yokka, wabula ne ku lutalo olw’omwoyo olw’okwegayiririra: “byonna bye mulisiba ku nsi, ne mu ggulu birisibwa ne bye mulisumulula ku nsi, ne mu ggulu bigenda kusumululwa” (Matayo 18:18). Omwegayirizi eyali afunye ddala ettaka mu kusaba yali akyusizza embeera ey’omwoyo ebintu mwe byatambulira.

Howells era yayigiriza nti okwegayiririra kusimbiddwa mu kuba nti Kristo ye Mwegayirizi asembayo. “Era kyava ayinza okulokolera ddala abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza” (Abaebbulaniya 7:25). Abayizi ba Howells bwe baafukamiranga ekiro kyonna mu kkanisa yaabwe ey’e Swansea, tebaali bagezaako kusikiriza Katonda abafeeko — baali beegatta ku kwegayiririra kw’Omwana ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe, nga bongera eddoboozi lyabwe ery’oku nsi ku kusaba okw’omu ggulu okwali kugenda mu maaso dda. Baali bakolera wamu ne Mukama eyazuukira mu mulimu ogusinga obukulu mu bitonde byonna.

Omuwendo gw’okwegayiririra okw’engeri eno gwali munene, era Howells teyagukendeezangako. Naye n’ebibala byali tebiwakanyizika. Yakkiriza nti Isaaya 62:6–7 kyannyonnyola omulimu omwegayirizi gw’alagiddwa: “Ntadde abakuumi ku bbugwe wo, ggwe Yerusaalemi abataasirike emisana n’ekiro. Mmwe abakoowoola Mukama temuwummula. Era temumuganya kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi” (Isaaya 62:6–7). Omukuumi teyasabanga lw’ayagadde. Teyalekanga kifo kye ng’ekiro kiwanvuye. Yakuumanga n’asaba awatali kuwummula kubanga ekibuga ekyali emabega we kyamwesigamangako. Kuno tekwali kuyitibwa kwa kwolesa ddiini. Kwali kuyitibwa kwa kwagala — okwagala okw’obuziba ennyo nga tekuyinza kutuula butuuzi ng’emyoyo n’amawanga biri ku mugo.

Essaala

Mukama, yimusa mu mulembe gwaffe abeegayirizi abanaayimiriranga mu mwagaanya nga Rees Howells bwe yakola — abo ababala omuwendo, abayingira mu lutalo, era abagaana okuwummula okutuusa nga by’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi. Amakanisa gaffe gafuuke ddala nnyumba za kusabiramu eri amawanga gonna. Amiina.

Baali bakolera wamu ne Mukama eyazuukira mu mulimu ogusinga obukulu mu bitonde byonna. Omuwendo gw’okwegayiririra okw’engeri eno gwali munene, era Howells teyagukendeezangako. Naye n’ebibala byali tebiwakanyizika. Yakkiriza nti Isaaya 62:6–7 kyannyonnyola omulimu omwegayirizi gw’alagiddwa: “Ntadde abakuumi ku bbugwe wo, ggwe Yerusaalemi abataasirike emisana n’ekiro. fields.title: Hudson Taylor — Omusajja Eyanyeenya Katonda olw’Okusaba Kwokka
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

James Hudson Taylor yazaalibwa nga 21 Maayi 1832, e Barnsley, mu Yorkshire, nga mutabani w’omubuulizi wa Methodist atali musumba, eyasabiranga buli kiseera ku maapu ya Bucayina, ng’akkiriza nti Katonda yandiggulawo obwakabaka obwo obunene eri Enjiri. Bwe yalokolebwa ng’alina emyaka kkumi na musanvu, Taylor amangu ago yatandika okwetegekera Bucayina — ng’ayiga Olumandalini, ng’asoma eby’obusawo, era ng’akangavvula omubiri gwe okugumira obuzibu. Yatuuka e Shanghai mu 1854 ng’alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu gumu, n’amala emyaka amakumi ataano egyaddirira ng’akulembera omulimu gw’obuminsani bw’Abapulotesitanti ogusinga obugazi mu byafaayo bya Bucayina; yatandikawo China Inland Mission mu 1865, eyakula n’efuna abaminsani abasukka mu 800 ng’akyali mulamu. Yafiira e Changsha, mu Bucayina, nga 3 Juuni 1905 — ng’akyali mu nsi gye yawaayo obulamu bwe okutuusaako Enjiri — ng’azimbye buli ddaala omulimu ogwo lye gwatuukako ku musingi gw’okusaba okutongole, okutakoowa, era okusimbye emirandira mu Byawandiikibwa.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Hudson Taylor oboolyawo asinga kumanyibwa olw’ekyo kye yayita “enkola y’okukkiriza” — okukakasa nti abo abeesiga Katonda ku lw’omulimu Gwe basaanidde okutegeeza Katonda yekka bye beetaaga, awatali kusaba bantu lwatu, awatali kusonda ssente nga kibiina, era awatali bbanja. Enkola eno teyali tteeka lya kibiina eryayiiyizibwa ku lwa China Inland Mission; yali eva mu ndowooza ku kusaba Taylor gye yali azudde ng’afukamidde mu maaso ga Katonda, emirundi mingi ng’ali mu bwetaavu obw’amazima. Mu bwavu obw’amaanyi obw’emyaka gye egyasooka mu Bucayina, yali azudde nti Katonda mwesigwa mu ngeri entegeka yonna ey’abantu ey’okuyamba gy’etayinza kukoppa — era nti okuleeta ebyetaago by’ensimbi ebitongole eri Katonda mu kusaba kyokka kyali kkubo ery’amaanyi ery’okukuza okukkiriza, eri oyo asaba n’eri abo abaalabanga okuddibwamu nga kutuuka.

Ekigambo kya Taylor ekisinga okujulizibwa ku kusaba n’okukkiriza kyali: “Teweetaaga kukkiriza kunene, wabula okukkiriza mu Katonda omukulu.” Yali alabye abaminsani abapya nga batuuka e Bucayina n’obunyiikivu bungi — “okukkiriza okunene,” bw’opimisa amaaso — n’alaba obunyiikivu obwo nga bugwa wansi w’akanyigo akatakoma ak’obuzibu, ebibala ebirwawo, n’okusaba okutaddibwamu. Ekizibu tekyali kukkiriza kutono; kyali kukkiriza okuteekeddwa awakyamu — okukkiriza mu busobozi bw’omuntu bwe obw’okukkiriza, mu kifo ky’empisa z’Oyo gwe bakkiriza.

Taylor yazzangayo abaminsani be, naye yennyini, emirundi n’emirundi ku lwazi lw’empisa za Katonda, ezisinga okwogerwa mu bufunze mu kisuubizo kya Pawulo: “Kale ne Katonda wange alibawa buli kye mwetaaga ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli” (Abafiripi 4:19). Kino tekyali kusuubira kwa bulijjo. Kyali kisuubizo kitongole okuva eri Katonda omutongole — era Taylor yakitwala nga ceeke ey’okuleeta mu bbanka n’obwesige.

Taylor yayigirizanga n’amaanyi ag’enjawulo ku nkolagana wakati w’okusaba n’okwagala kwa Katonda. Teyakkiriza nti okusaba kye kyuma omukkiriza mw’akyusiza okwagala kwa Katonda kudde ku by’ayagala ye. Yakkiriza ekyo ekikontana nakyo: nti okusaba kye kkubo Katonda mw’akyusiza omukkiriza by’ayagala bidde ku kwagala Kwe. Ekigendererwa ky’okusaba tekyali kuleetera Katonda kukola ky’oyagala, wabula okufuuka omuntu by’ayagala ebigenda bikwatagana ennyo n’ebyo Katonda bye yamala dda okumalirira okukola. Enkyukakyuka eno yajja olw’okwebbika mu Byawandiikibwa obutayosa, n’olw’empisa ey’okuleetanga buli lunaku entegeka ze, okutya kwe, n’okwegomba kwe mu maaso ga Katonda n’abirekayo.

Yabumbibwa nnyo Abafiripi 4:6–7 — si ng’enjigiriza ey’okukkiriza obukkiriza, wabula ng’empisa ey’okukolerako buli lunaku: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:6–7). Abo abaabeeranga era abaakolanga okumpi ennyo ne Taylor baayogeranga ku mirembe egy’omunda egitannyonnyolekeka, egyagumanga mu bikangabwa ebyandimenye abasajja abatali ba maanyi. Mukyala we eyasooka, Maria, yafiira mu Bucayina. Abaana be abawerako baafa nga bawere oba nga bato. Obujeemu bw’Aba-Boxer mu 1900 bwaviirako okuttibwa kw’abaminsani be 58 n’abaana baabwe 21. Naye abo abaamulaba mu bikangabwa bino tebaayogera ku muntu eyali anyigiriza ennaku ye, wabula ku muntu eyali akwatiddwa ddala, mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda — ng’olinga ekisuubizo ky’Abafiripi 4:7 kyali kifuuliddwa ekya ddala era ekirabika mu ye.

Taylor era yakkiririza mu kusaba okutongole. Teyasabanga mu bigambo ebya bulijjo ebitategeerekeka — “Mukama, wa Bucayina omukisa” — wabula mu bisabo ebituufu, ebituumiddwa amannya. Engeri okuddibwamu gye kwajjangamu yali nnywevu nnyo n’efuuka empisa y’omwoyo eya China Inland Mission yonna: tuuma ky’oyagala, kireete eri Katonda, suubira okuddibwamu okutongole, wandiika okuddibwamu bwe kujja. Empisa eno yalina emirandira emiwanvu mu by’eddiini — Yesu yennyini yali agambye nti “Musabe, munaaweebwa” (Matayo 7:7), era Taylor yatwala Yesu ku kigambo Kye mu ngeri ey’ennukuta ddala.

Omuguwa ogwayita mu njigiriza ya Taylor yonna ku kusaba gwali bwesige obutanyeenyezeka mu mpisa za Katonda. “Katonda waffe Katonda mwesigwa,” bwe yagambanga — era yakitegeezanga mu makulu agasinga okuba ag’ennukuta. Yeremiya 33:3 kyakyogera bulungi: “Mumpite n’abayitaba ne mbalaga ebikulu ebitanoonyezeka bye mutamanyi”. Obulamu bwa Taylor bwali okuddamu okuwanvu era okwakaayakana eri okuyita okwo — obujulizi obw’emyaka amakumi ataano nti Katonda agamba nti “Mumpite” akitegeeza ddala, era nti oyo akoowoola taliswala.

Essaala

Katonda Kitaffe, tuwe okukkiriza kwa Hudson Taylor — si kukkiriza mu maanyi g’enneewulira zaffe, wabula okukkiriza okusimbye emirandira mu bukakafu bw’empisa Zo. Tuyigirize okusaba mu ngeri entongole, okwesiga n’obugumiikiriza, n’okuzuula nti Katonda atuyita bulijjo atuwa buli kyetaago okuyitibwa okwo kye kwetaaga. Amiina.

fields.title: E. M. Bounds — Omutume w’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Edward McKendree Bounds yazaalibwa nga 15 Agusito 1835, mu Shelby County, mu Missouri. Yasomera eby’amateeka, era ng’aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano, n’addamu okuyitibwa okuweereza mu Kkanisa ya Methodist. Bwe yakwatibwa amagye ga Union mu Lutalo lw’Omunda olw’Amerika n’asibibwa ng’omusibe w’olutalo, yaddayo mu busumba ng’olutalo luwedde, era emyaka gye egy’enkomerero yagimalira mu Washington, mu Georgia — ng’agolokoka ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro buli makya, ng’awaayo essaawa ssatu oba nnya ezisooka eri okusaba, n’oluvannyuma ng’awandiika okutuusa emirimu emirala lwe gyamuyitanga. Bwe yafa mu 1913 yali awandiise ebitabo munaana ku kusaba, musanvu ku byo ne bifulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa, era bibumbye obulamu bw’okusaba obw’abaweereza n’abakkiriza aba bulijjo mu nsi yonna okumala emyaka egisukka mu kikumi. Y’omusajja asinga okujulizibwa ku kusaba mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa eyogera Olungereza.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Ekyasinga okutegeka obulamu bwa Bounds n’omulimu gwe kyali kino: obuzibu bw’ekkanisa obusinga okwanguyirwa tebwali nsobi mu njigiriza oba kwonoona mpisa — bwali butasaba. Si butabaawo mikolo gya kusaba oba okulagajjalira enkola z’okusinza, wabula obutasaba obw’omunda obusinga okuzikiriza, obw’abaweereza n’abakkiriza abaali baweddemu okutegeera nti okusaba kye kikolwa ekisinga obukulu kye bayinza okukola. Buli kirala kyali kiva ku kino. Ekkanisa etasaba yali ekkanisa etambula ku maanyi g’abantu — era amaanyi g’abantu, ne bwe galabika ng’ag’ekitalo okumala ekiseera, gandikooye ne gataleeta kya mirembe na mirembe.

Bounds yawandiika ng’alinga nnabbi alanga: “Ekkanisa ky’eyetaaga leero si byuma bingi oba ebisingako obulungi, si bibiina bipya oba enkola empya ezeewuunyisa, wabula abasajja Omwoyo Omutukuvu b’ayinza okukozesa — abasajja ab’okusaba, abasajja ab’amaanyi mu kusaba.” Yakobo yali akyogedde kaati: “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo” (Yakobo 5:16). Era ekyokulabirako kya Eriya mu lunyiriri oluddako — “muntu ddala nga ffe” eyasaba enkuba n’eziyizibwa, n’addamu okusaba n’etonnya — kyalaga nti amaanyi gano tegaali ga bantu ba njawulo bokka, wabula ga basajja n’abakazi aba bulijjo abaali beetegefu okusaba obutayosa n’obunyiikivu obw’ekitalo.

Bounds yassanga nnyo essira ku bunyiikivu bw’okusaba — kye yayawula ennyo ku kusaba emirundi emingi obuyitirivu. Omuntu yali ayinza okukuuma omukolo gw’okusaba emirundi ebiri buli lunaku okumala emyaka amakumi ataano nga tasabangako, singa ebigambo bye tebyali bivudde mu kwegomba kwa mwoyo okw’amazima n’okwesigama ku Katonda olw’obwetaavu obw’amaanyi. Obunyiikivu, Bounds bwe yayigiriza, tebwali kucamuka mu nneewulira oba okweraga; bwali mbeera ya mutima ogwategeera obunene bw’obwetaavu bwagwo n’obungi bw’ebyo Katonda by’agaba. Obunyiikivu, nga Bounds bwe yabutegeera, bwali okukkiriza okuwulira obuzito bwakwo.

Yayogera nnyo ku nkolagana wakati w’ebiseera n’okusaba, ng’akakasa nti tewali kiyinza kudda mu kifo ky’ebiseera ebiwanvu ebitali bya kwanguyiriza, ebiweebwa Katonda yekka. Yeesigama ku kyokulabirako kya Yesu: “Enkeera ng’obudde tebunnalaba yesu n’azuukuka n’agenda yekka mu kifo ekyekusifu, okusaba” (Makko 1:35). Singa Omwana wa Katonda, mwe kwali okutuukirira kwonna okw’Obwakatonda, yalaba nga kyetaagisa okugolokoka obudde nga tebunnakya n’amala ebiseera ebiwanvu yekka ne Kitaawe, abagoberezi Be baasinziira ku ki okulowooza nti eddakiika kkumi n’ettaano nga tebannalya kya makya zandimala? Bounds yakibuuza obutakoowa era awatali kwetonda. Okusaba tekwali kya kuteeka ku mabbali g’obulamu obujjudde emirimu. Kwe musingi obulamu obw’omugaso kwe buzimbibwa.

Bounds era yawandiika n’amaanyi ku nkolagana wakati w’Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’okusaba okuvaamu ebibala, ng’asinziira ku bukakafu bwa Pawulo nti “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26). Yayigiriza nti obumu ku buweereza bw’Omwoyo obukulu kwe kukyusa oyo asaba — okutwala omutima omunyogovu, ogutawaanyizibwa, ogwerowoozaako, n’agubugumya n’okwegomba kwa Katonda. Yuda 1:20 kyalagira: “Naye mmwe, abaagalwa, musaana okuzimba obulamu bwammwe nga bweyongera okuba obw’amaanyi, nga mubuzimbira ku musingi ogw’okukkiriza kwammwe okutukuvu, era nga musaba mu Mwoyo Mutukuvu...” — era Bounds yakkiriza nti ekiragiro ekyo kya kukolerako nga bwe kiri ekizibu.

Ku nkomerero, Bounds yategeera okusaba ng’ennimiro mwe mumera obuweereza bwonna obw’amazima. Okusaba okw’omu kyama gye mirandira gy’ebibala ebirabika mu lwatu. Abaebbulaniya 7:25 kyayogera ku Yesu ng’oyo “abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza” — bulijjo, awatali kusalako, awatali kuwummula. fields.title: George Müller — Omusajja Eyasaba Abaana Bamulekwa ne Balya
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

George Müller yazaalibwa mu 1805 mu Prussia, nga mutabani w’omusolooza w’omusolo, era nga ye yennyini bw’akyatula awatali kukweka, emyaka gye egyasooka yagimala mu bukuusa, mu bubbi obutono, ne mu butamiivu — n’asibibwa n’akaseera katono ng’akyali muvubuka. Mu 1825, bwe yali mu lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba mu maka g’omuntu, yasisinkana Katonda omulamu era n’akyusibwa. Yasenga mu Bristol, mu Bungereza, ne yeegatta ku kibiina kya Plymouth Brethren, era mu 1836 n’aggulawo ennyumba ye esooka ey’abaana bamulekwa nga kumpi talina kintu mu ngalo. Mu bulamu bwe bwonna obw’obuweereza yalabirira abaana bamulekwa abasukka mu 10,000, n’atandikawo amasomero 117 agaawa abaana 120,000 okusoma okw’Ekikristaayo, era n’ayamba abaminsani bikumi na bikumi mu nsi yonna — byonna awatali kusaba muntu yenna ssente lwatu, byonna olw’okusaba kwokka. Yawandiika essaala ezisukka mu 50,000 ezaddibwamu nga tannafa mu 1898 ng’alina emyaka kyenda mu ebiri.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Ejjinja ery’oku nsonda ery’obulamu bwa Müller bwonna obw’okusaba lyali bwangu obw’amaanyi: twala Katonda ku kigambo Kye. Si ku kulowooza okutategeerekeka ku ebyo ebiyinza okubaawo mu mwoyo, si ku nneewulira oba ku kuwulira okw’eddiini okw’essuubi — wabula ku bisuubizo Bye ebiwandiikiddwa mu Byawandiikibwa nga bwe biri ddala, kigambo ku kigambo. Müller yalondanga ekisuubizo ekitongole, n’akifumiitirizaako okutuusa lwe yakakasanga nti kikwata ku mbeera ye, n’oluvannyuma n’akireeta mu maaso ga Katonda ng’ensibuko y’ekyo ky’asaba — mu kkakkamu, n’obugumiikiriza, era n’obwesige obunywevu obw’omuntu akutte mu ngalo ekiwandiiko ekiteekeddwako omukono. Ekyokulabirako kye yasinga okwagala kyali kya ceeke: omuntu akutte ceeke entuufu ku akawunti erimu ssente tazeegayirira bbanka okugisasula. Agireeta n’alinda okusasulwa kuggwe.

Ekyawandiikibwa kye yasinga okuddangamu kyali ekisuubizo kya Yesu yennyini: “Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo. Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo” (Matayo 7:7–8). Müller yakkiriza nti ekigambo “buli” kye kigambo ekisinga obukulu mu kitundu ekyo. Si buli muntu omukulu mu mwoyo — buli asaba. Ekisuubizo kyali kya bonna, era Müller yagaana okukitwala ng’ekitono ku ekyo. Yawandiika: “Entandikwa y’okweraliikirira y’enkomerero y’okukkiriza, n’entandikwa y’okukkiriza okw’amazima y’enkomerero y’okweraliikirira.” Kino kyali kukkiriza kw’omuntu eyali agezesezza ekisuubizo emirundi omutwalo gumu n’akisanga nga kyesigika buli mulundi.

Müller era yayigiriza nti embeera y’omutima mu maaso ga Katonda teyawukana ku maanyi g’okusaba. Yeegenderezanga okwatula ekibi ky’amanyi nga tannaleeta bye yeetaaga eri Katonda, era yakakasanga nti obutasonyiwa obutagonjoddwa, obujeemu obugenderere, oba omutima ogwesudde wabiri bye bisenge ebinene ebiziyiza omugga gw’okusaba okuddibwamu. Yasinziiranga ku 1 Yokaana 3:22 — “Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa” — si ng’enkola ey’okufuna olw’ebikolwa, wabula ng’amazima ag’enkolagana: okusaba okuddibwamu kuyita mu mutima ogutunuulidde ddala Katonda mu buwulize n’okwagala.

Essira lye eryasinga okumwawula lyali ku mpisa ey’okusaba okutongole olw’ebyetaago ebitongole, n’okusuubira okutongole okw’okuddibwamu okutongole. Müller yakuumanga ebitabo by’okusaba ebijjuvu, ng’awandiika olunaku lwennyini, ekisabo kyennyini, n’okuddibwamu kwennyini ku buli emu ku ssaala ze ezisukka mu nkumi amakumi ataano ze yawandiika.

Buli kuddibwamu okwawandiikibwa kwali jjinja mu kijjukizo ky’obwesigwa bwa Katonda. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yali akitegedde: “Mulegeeko mulabe nga Mukama bw’ali omulungi” (Zabbuli 34:8). Müller yali alegedde, emirundi n’emirundi, era teyaggwaamu kwegomba.

Emu ku ngero ezisinga okumanyika okuva mu mayumba g’abaana bamulekwa ag’e Ashley Down eraga endowooza ye ku kusaba. Lumu ku makya, abaana bikumi bisatu baatuula okulya ekyenkya — naye nga mu nnyumba temuli wadde akamere akamu. Müller yeebaza olw’emmere ng’alinga eyali emaze okuweebwa. Eddakiika ntono oluvannyuma, omufumbi w’emigaati n’akonkona ku mulyango ng’aleese emigaati egyafikka gye bataasuubira. Nga tebannagigabanya, omutunzi w’amata n’alabika: eggaali lye lyali lifiiridde wabweru w’emiryango era nga yeetaaga okuwanula amata ge gonna amaggya. Tewali mwana n’omu yasubwa kya kulya. Eri Müller, kino kyali kutuukirira kwa bulijjo okwa Makko 11:24: “Noolwekyo mbagamba nti buli kye munaasabanga, mukkirize nti mukiweereddwa, era kinaabanga bwe kityo gye muli”. Yali akkirizza. Yali afunye. Nga bwe yali afunanga bulijjo.

Enjigiriza ya Müller esembayo, era oboolyawo esinga obukulu, yali ku kigendererwa ky’okusaba okuddibwamu: tekyali ku lw’omugaso gw’oyo asaba okusingira ddala, wabula olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Obulamu bwe bwali bujulizi obw’emyaka nsanvu nti Ebyawandiikibwa byesigika. Nga Pawulo bwe yawandiika: “Kaakano nsaba nti oyo akola ebintu byonna okusinga byonna bye tusaba, ne bye tulowooza, ng’amaanyi ge bwe gali agakolera mu ffe, agulumizibwenga” (Abaefeso 3:20–21). Müller yali azudde nti “okusinga byonna bye tusaba” si kwongeza kwa bayiiya, wabula kunnyonnyola okutuufu okw’engeri Katonda gy’akolamu ddala abantu Be bwe basaba ddala.

Essaala

Kitaffe, tuwe okukkiriza okwangu, okw’omwana omuto, okwa George Müller — okukkiriza okukutwala ku Kigambo Kyo awatali kubuusabuusa, okukkiriza okufukamira mu maaso g’akabada akakalu ne kugolokoka nga kusuubira n’obwesige. Tuyigirize okukufuula Ggwe ekyamaanyi kyaffe ekisooka, so si ekyokwekwasa ekisembayo. Amiina.

fields.title: John Praying Hyde — Omutume w’Okusaba mu Buyindi
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

John Nelson Hyde yazaalibwa nga 9 Novemba 1865, e Carrollton, mu Illinois, nga mutabani w’omusumba w’Abapresbyteriya eyasabanga Katonda asindike abakozi mu makungula Ge. Bwe yamala okusoma mu ttendekero ly’eby’eddiini erya McCormick Theological Seminary mu 1892, Hyde yasaabala okugenda mu kitundu ky’e Punjab mu bukiikakkono bwa Buyindi, ng’alina obuggavu bw’amatu obw’ekitundu — embeera abo abaamwagala gye baatwala ng’engeri Katonda gye yaggalawo okutu kwe okw’ebweru eri oluyoogaano lw’ensi n’agguliza ddala okutu kwe okw’omunda eri eggulu.

Yakolera mu Buyindi okumala kumpi emyaka amakumi abiri, n’afuuka omwegayirizi asinga okumanyika mu mulembe gwe, era n’afa ekizimba ekibi mu 1912, ng’alina emyaka amakumi ana mu mukaaga, ng’omubiri gwe gukooye ddala. Yaleka emabega abakkiriza Abayindi abaamukungubagira nga kitaabwe, n’omusika gw’okusaba ogukyalaga kye kitegeeza okuba omwegayirizi.

Obulamu bwa Hyde obw’okusaba tebuyinza kutegeerekeka nga tolowoozezza ku kintu ekyabufuga: omugugu. Teyatwala kusaba ng’empisa ey’okukuuma oba omulimu ogw’okutuukiriza. Yakutwala ng’obuzito bwe yali tayinza kussa wansi — okwagala okw’omunda ennyo, okulumya, okuweebwa Omwoyo, eri abantu b’e Buyindi abatannalokolebwa, okwalabikiranga mu kwegayirira okutakoma, okw’amaziga, era okw’obulumi. Abo abaamumanya baayogera ku muntu eyalabikanga ng’azitoowereddwa mu mubiri olw’okubula kw’abantu mu mwoyo okwamwetooloola, ng’alinga awulira nga kumunyiga mu kifuba. Kino tekyali kwennyamira oba kweraga mu ddiini. Kyali kuyiika okw’amazima okw’okwagala Omwoyo Omutukuvu kwe yali amuteekeddemu — okwagala okutaalina ngeri ndala ematiza kwe kwolesebwamu wabula mu kusaba.

Yalaga mu bulamu bwe ekyo Pawulo kye yannyonnyola mu Abaggalatiya 4:19 — “Baana bange be nnumirwa nate ng’alumwa okuzaala, okutuusa Kristo lw’alibumbibwa mu mmwe.” Omwegayirizi atwala ddala omugugu gw’emmeeme y’omulala tamala gamwogerako eri Katonda; amulumirwa n’amaanyi ag’omukazi ali mu ssaawa ezisinga obuzibu ez’okuzaala — ng’anyigiriza, ng’asinda, ng’agaana okuleka okutuusa okuzaalibwa okw’omwoyo lwe kubaawo. Hyde yali afunye omugugu ogw’engeri eno ku lw’abantu kinnoomu, ku lw’abakozi Abayindi n’abaminsani abaakuŋŋaananga mu lukuŋŋaana olwa buli mwaka olw’e Sialkot, ne ku lw’ekibiina ekinene eky’obukadde bwa Buyindi abatawulirangako linnya lya Yesu.

Pawulo bwe yannyonnyola okusinda kw’Omwoyo yennyini — “Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26) — eri Hyde tekyali kubudaabuda kwa njigiriza kwokka; kye kyali amazima ge yalabanga mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba. Yali kibya bubya okuyitamu okwegayirira kw’Omwoyo yennyini mwe kwatambuliranga.

Ebibala ebyava mu bulamu bwa Hyde obw’okusaba byali bya kwewuunya. Ebiwandiiko eby’okusinza bigamba nti okumpi n’olukuŋŋaana lw’e Sialkot olwa 1908 yakola endagaano ne Katonda ku lw’emmeeme emu waakiri buli lunaku, n’alaba abasukka mu bikumi bina nga bajja eri Kristo mu mwaka ogwo; nti yalinnyisa okusaba kwe n’atuuka ku bbiri buli lunaku, n’oluvannyuma ku nnya. Tewali kiwandiiko kya buminsani eky’omu kiseera ekyo ekikakasa emiwendo egyo ddala, naye ennimiro gye yasabira ekyewa obujulizi: e Moga, gye yakolera mu myaka gye egy’enkomerero, abaabatizibwa beeyongera buli mwaka okutuusa 685 lwe baabatizibwa mu 1910. Ebibala byeyongera nga bwe gwenkana omugugu gwe yali mwetegefu okwetikka. Kino tekyali nkola gye yali akozesa; yali nkolagana gye yali agenda ayongera okunywezaamu. Buli mwaka gw’okusaba gwali gwongedde okumanya kwe ku mutima gwa Katonda eri Buyindi, ne gwongera obusobozi bwe obw’okwetikka omugugu, ne gugaziya obwesige bwe nti Katonda okwagala abaabula okulokolebwa kwali kunene n’okusinga okwagala kwe ye.

Hyde yayigiriza mu kyokulabirako kye nti okwegayirira okwegatta n’oyo asabirwa — okusaba okuyingira mu mbeera y’oyo gw’osabira — kwe kusaba okusinga okuba okw’omuwendo omunene era okusinga okuvaamu ebibala. Teyasabiranga baabula ab’e Buyindi ng’ali wala mu bukuumi n’eddembe. Yabakaabiranga. Oluusi yamalanga ennaku nga talya, si lwa kweraga mu mwoyo, wabula kubanga omugugu gwe yali yeetisse gwali muzito nnyo nga tegulekayo kifo kya kulumwa njala. Guno gwe mwoyo gw’Abaruumi 9:1–3, Pawulo w’awandiikira — n’amaanyi agewuunyisa — nti yandyagadde yennyini akolimirwe Katonda singa ekyo kyandireese obulokozi bw’abantu be. Hyde yasasula omuwendo ogwo n’omutima gumu, era ebyavaamu byalabikira mu bibala bye ne mu mubiri gwe.

Era yasabanga n’okukkiriza okw’ekitalo — okukkiriza okukkakkamu era okunywevu okw’omuntu eyali amaze essaawa nnyingi nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda nga takyayinza kubuusabuusa ddala nti Katonda ayagala okulokola. Yasabanga ng’asinziira ku kwagala Katonda kwe yennyini kwe yayatula: “Mukama waffe taludde kutuukiriza ekyo kye yasuubiza ng’abamu bwe balowooza. Wabula ye akyabagumiikiriza, nga tayagala muntu yenna kubula, naye bonna beenenye” (2 Peetero 3:9). Hyde bwe yasabiranga emmeeme okulokolebwa, teyabanga asaba Katonda kukola kintu ky’atayagala kukola. Yabanga yeegatta ku kwagala kw’omutima gwa Katonda yennyini — era okukwatagana okwo okw’okwagala kw’omwegayirizi n’okwagala kwa Katonda kye kyennyini kyaleetera essaala ze okuddibwamu obutayosa.

Omusika gwa Praying Hyde (Hyde Omusabi) kunenya okw’olubeerera eri okusaba okutono, okw’amangu, okutaliimu kufaayo, okuyitibwa okwegayirira mu bitundu bingi eby’ekkanisa ey’ennaku zino — era kuyita kw’olubeerera eri ekintu ekisingawo obuziba. Ebigambo bya Yakobo bya mazima mu buli mulembe: “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo” (Yakobo 5:16). Hyde yali mutuukirivu — si lwa bulungi bwe ye, wabula mu Kristo. Era okusaba kwe kwalina obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu byali bya ttendo. Ebyo byombi biri eri buli mukkiriza eyeetegefu okusasula omuwendo gw’okwegayirira okw’amazima.

Essaala

Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tuwe ku mugugu Praying Hyde gwe yeetikka — okwagala abaabula okw’omunda ennyo okututuusa ku maviivi, okusaasira abazibe b’amaaso mu mwoyo okw’amaanyi ennyo ne tutawummula okutuusa nga balabye. Tujjuze okwegayirira Kwo kwennyini ku lw’ensi etamanyi Mulokozi waayo. Amiina.

fields.title: David Brainerd — Omuliro Ogwaka Ennyo Okumala Akaseera Akatono
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

David Brainerd yazaalibwa nga 20 Apuli 1718, e Haddam, mu Connecticut, mu maka g’Abapulitaani agaakubwa ennaku nga bukyali — bazadde be bombi baafa nga tannaweza myaka kkumi na etaano. Yayingira mu Yale mu 1739 nga Okuzuukuka Okunene (Great Awakening) kuli ku ntikko yaakwo, n’agobebwa mu 1742 olw’ekigambo kye yayogera awatali kwegendereza mu kiseera eky’empaka ez’eddiini, era Abakongulegesonali (Congregationalists) ne bagaana okumwawula okuba omusumba.

Ekibiina kya Society in Scotland for Propagating Christian Knowledge kye kyamutuma, n’aweereza ng’omuminsani mu Bazaaliranwa b’Amerika mu New York, New Jersey ne Pennsylvania okutuusa lwe yafa akafuba mu 1747 ng’alina emyaka abiri mu mwenda — mu maka ga Jonathan Edwards, eyalongoosa ekitabo kye eky’ebijjukizo n’akifulumya. Okuva olwo ekitabo ekyo kisindise abantu bangi mu nnimiro y’obuminsani okusinga oboolyawo ekiwandiiko ekirala kyonna ekitali kya Bayibuli mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa; kyagalwa nnyo William Carey, John Wesley, Jim Elliot, n’Abakristaayo aba bulijjo obukadde n’obukadde mu byasa bisatu.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Ekitabo kya Brainerd eky’ebijjukizo, mu bukulu bwakyo, njigiriza ku kusaba ewandiikiddwa si mu nsonga ezirambikiddwa, wabula mu bye yayitamu.

Si kitabo kyangu. Kiwandiiko ekituufu, ekitaliiko kwekweka, eky’emmeeme eyali kumpi bulijjo mu bulumi — okwennyamira okw’amaanyi, oluusi n’atasobola na kusituka ku kitanda kye; okuba yekka okwamuluma ennyo, n’awulira ng’abeera “ng’ekitonde ekyagobebwa mu nsi,” n’obunafu bw’omubiri obungi, oluusi n’abuulira ng’amawuggwe ge gavaamu omusaayi.

Kyokka mu ebyo byonna, era okusinga ddala olw’ebyo byonna, yatuuka mu buziba bw’okusaba banne abaali mu mbeera ennyangu bwe bataatuukako.

Ekikulu mu njigiriza ya Brainerd ku kusaba kwali kumala kwa Katonda kwonna mu maaso g’obutamala bw’omusabi bwonna. Teyalina ky’aleeta eri Katonda — si bulamu bulungi, si bwogezi, si kikula kisikiriza, si bintu bya kutegeka. Kye yalina gwali mwoyo ogumenyese n’obwetaavu obw’amaanyi. Era n’azuula nti ekyo, mu nteekateeka ya Katonda, kye kyennyini ekyali kyetaagisa: “Ssaddaaka Katonda gy’ayagala gwe mwoyo ogutegedde okusobya kwagwo. Omutima ogumenyese era oguboneredde, Ayi Katonda, toogugayenga” (Zabbuli 51:17). Okumenyeka kwe tekwali buzibu bwa mwoyo bwa kuwangula, wabula kisaanyizo kya mwoyo Katonda kye yassaamu ekitiibwa. Buli kuzuukuka mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa kwasookebwako okusaba okw’engeri eno — okusaba kw’abantu abaali basigaddeko Katonda yekka, era abaali bazudde nti Katonda, mu mazima, yali amala.

Brainerd yamalanga ennaku eziwera mu ddungu okwetooloola akayumba ke akatono, ng’avuunamye ku ttaka eryali likutte omuzira, ng’asabira Abazaaliranwa be yali abeera nabo. Ebiseera bino abinnyonnyola bulungi nnyo, omusomi n’awulira obunnyogovu bw’ettaka wansi we n’obuzito bw’eggulu waggulu we. Teyali ng’alaga butukuvu eri abalaba; tewaaliwo balaba. Yali muvubuka mulwadde ali yekka mu ddungu, ng’anoonya Katonda n’ebyo byonna bye yalina — ebitaali bingi — n’azuula nti Katonda kye yamuddizanga kyali buli kye yali yeetaaga. Yawandiika ku “kumeggana ne Katonda mu kusaba,” n’ava mu biseera bino si na maanyi ag’obuwanguzi ag’abalina emibiri emigumu, wabula n’ekintu ekikkakkamu, ekiwangaala, era eky’amaanyi okusingawo: okukakasa okunywevu nti Katonda yali amuwulidde.

Okuzuukuka okw’e Crossweeksung, mu New Jersey, mu Agusito 1745, kye kyali ekibala ekyennyini eky’okusaba kuno.

Brainerd yali amaze emyezi mingi ng’asabira ekitundu ky’Abadelaware eky’eyo, emirundi mingi ng’ayogera amannya g’abantu kinnoomu, era emirundi mingi ng’akaaba amaziga. Omwoyo bwe yakka nga 8 Agusito, yakka n’amaanyi agaaleetera ekitundu kyonna okukaaba, okulumirizibwa mu mwoyo, n’okukoowoola nga basaba okusaasirwa. Brainerd yennyini yali mulwadde nnyo kumpi n’atasobola kulaba ebyali bibaawo, naye yakitegeera awatali kubuusabuusa: kuno kwali kuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Si lwa nsonga ze ez’eby’eddiini ez’amagezi, oba obukugu bwe mu kwogera — wabula lwa kusaba kwe. Zekkaliya 4:6 kyandibadde ekigambo ekikulembera obuweereza bwe bwonna: “‘Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange,’ bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye”.

Era yayigiriza, ng’akyolesa mu bulamu bwe, enkolagana eriwo wakati w’obwesimbu bw’omuntu n’okwegayiririra okubala ebibala.

Brainerd yeekebereranga nnyo awatali kwesaasira. Ebijjukizo bye birimu emirundi mingi mw’atulira amalala, obunnyogovu bw’omwoyo, obutanywera mu by’omwoyo, n’okukemebwa okw’okuggwamu essuubi okwali kumuli kumpi buli kiseera. Buli kimu yakireetanga eri Katonda mu bwerufu obufudde ebijjukizo bye ebizibu okusoma eri emirembe mingi egy’Abakristaayo. Naye obwerufu bwe bwennyini bwali ngeri ya kusaba — eky’engeri Zabbuli 62:8 gy’ennyonnyola: “Mumwesigenga bulijjo mmwe abantu, mumutegeezenga byonna ebiri mu mitima gyammwe, kubanga Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe”. Brainerd yategeeza Katonda byonna ebyali mu mutima gwe — ebirungi n’ebibi, okukkiriza n’okubuusabuusa, okwagala n’obukoowu — n’asanga Katonda nga kiddukiro ekigazi ekimala okubitwala byonna.

Jonathan Edwards bwe yamala okusoma ebijjukizo bya Brainerd, yagamba nti byamuleetera okuyaayaanira obulamu bw’okusaba obuziba okusinga kumpi ekirala kyonna kye yali asomye. Omuvubuka eyafa ku myaka abiri mu mwenda, nga tamanyiddwa era nga tewali mu nsi ennene amukungubagira, akutte ku bulamu bw’okusaba obw’emirembe egyaddirira okusinga amannya mangi ag’ettutumu ag’omu kiseera kye. Kino kye kyewuunyo ekiri mu mutima gw’Obwakabaka: abo abaalabika ng’abasinga obunafu, okumenyeka n’okukwekebwa, emirundi mingi be baali amaanyi ga Katonda mwe gaakulukutira mu ddembe okusinga.

Essaala

Kiwandiiko ekituufu, ekitaliiko kwekweka, eky’emmeeme eyali kumpi bulijjo mu bulumi — okwennyamira okw’amaanyi, oluusi n’atasobola na kusituka ku kitanda kye; okuba yekka okwamuluma ennyo, n’awulira ng’abeera “ng’ekitonde ekyagobebwa mu nsi,” n’obunafu bw’omubiri obungi, oluusi n’abuulira ng’amawuggwe ge gavaamu omusaayi. Kyokka mu ebyo byonna, era okusinga ddala olw’ebyo byonna, yatuuka mu buziba bw’okusaba banne abaali mu mbeera ennyangu bwe bataatuukako. fields.title: Martin Luther — Omuddaabiriza Ali ku Maviivi Ge
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Martin Luther yazaalibwa nga 10 Novemba 1483, e Eisleben, mu Saxony, mutabani w’omusimi w’ekikomo eyalina ekirooto nti mutabani we omukulu alifuuka munnamateeka. Entiisa gye yafuna mu kibuyaga w’okubwatuka mu 1505 yasindika Luther mu kigo ky’abamonaki, era emyaka egyaddirira egy’okufuba okw’ekimonaki — okwekuba embooko, okwatula ebibi awatali kukoma, n’okwekebera obutakoowa — tegyasobola kukkakkanya muntu we ow’omunda eyali amubonyaabonya. Emirembe yagifuna bwe yazuula ekisa ng’asoma Abaruumi: obutuukirivu, bwe yayiga, si kye Katonda asaba aboonoonyi, wabula kirabo Katonda ky’abawa olw’okukkiriza Kristo. Okuzuula kuno kwakoleeza Okuddaabiriza Ekkanisa (Reformation) — Ensonga Kyenda mu Ttaano (Ninety-Five Theses) eza 1517, Olukiiko lw’e Worms mu 1521, Bayibuli ey’Olugirimaani, ennyimba, ebigambo bye yabuulira, n’amataba g’ebiwandiiko ebyakyusa Bulaaya. Wansi w’ebyo byonna waaliwo omusajja eyategeezebwa okumalanga essaawa bbiri oba ssatu buli ku makya ng’asaba — era eyafa mu 1546 ng’amaze okukyusa maapu y’eby’omwoyo ey’ensi ez’Amabugwanjuba ng’ali ku maviivi ge.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Okuddaabiriza kwa Luther, mu buli ddaala, kwali kuddaabiriza kusaba nga bwe kwali okuddaabiriza enjigiriza. Ekkanisa ey’omu Mirembe egy’Omu Makkati yali efudde okusaba omulimu gw’abakugu — omuze ogw’enjawulo ogukolebwa abamonaki ne bakabona ku lw’abantu aba bulijjo abaali tebamanyi kusoma era abaali beesigama ku balala mu by’omwoyo. Luther enkola eno yagimenyaamenya n’ekyokulwanyisa kye kimu eky’enjigiriza kye yakozesa okumenyaamenya okusonyiyibwa okutundibwa (indulgences) n’obuyinza bwa bakabona: obwakabona bw’abakkiriza bonna. Okuva buli Mukristaayo eyabatizibwa bwe yali ayimiridde mu maaso ga Katonda mu Kristo ng’alina ekkubo lye limu, ekifo kye kimu, n’okwanirizibwa okumu okuggule, buli Mukristaayo eyabatizibwa yali asobola era ng’asaanidde okusaba butereevu, ye kennyini, n’obuvumu, era ng’asuubira.

Okusaba tekwakwasibwa basumba bokka. Kwali busika bwa buli mwana wa Katonda.

Omusingi gw’enjigiriza eno gwali ekyawandiikibwa kye yaddangamu enfunda n’enfunda mu buweereza bwe bwonna: “Kale tusembererenga entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa n’obuvumu, tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe mu kwetaaga kwaffe” (Abaebbulaniya 4:16). Ekigambo “obuvumu” — parresia mu Luyonaani, ekitegeeza okuguma, eddembe ly’okwogera, n’obwerufu obutaliimu kwekweka — kyali kigambo ky’omuntu atalina ky’akweka wadde ky’alina kukakasa, ajja eri Katonda ng’omwana omwagalwa bw’ajja eri kitaawe asanyuka okumusemberera. Luther yanyiiganga nnyo olw’okusaba okw’ensonyi, okw’okwekyika n’okutya, okwali kusinga mu kwewaayo kw’abantu ab’omu kiseera kye. Yayagala abantu b’ekkanisa ze basabe n’obwenyi obubikkule, emimwa emiggule, n’emikono emiggule — nga basuubira okufuna okuva eri Kitaffe eyali yeetegese dda okugaba.

Yawandiika ekitabo ekyewuunyisa eky’okuyamba abantu okusaba mu ngeri y’ebbaluwa eri omumwi w’enviiri we, Peter Beskendorf — “Engeri Ennyangu ey’Okusaba” — ekyafuuka kimu ku biwandiiko by’obusumba ebyasinga okusomebwa mu kiseera ky’Okuddaabiriza. Yannyonnyola engeri gy’akozesaamu Essaala ya Mukama, Amateeka Ekkumi, n’Ekyatulwa ky’Abatume ng’enku ezikoleeza okusaba, so si ng’ebiwandiiko eby’okwatulira obwatuzi. Yakwatanga ekitundu — “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu” — n’akireka kikoleeze emboozi: Kitaffe ono y’ani?

Kitegeeza ki nti ali mu ggulu? Kiki kye mmanyi ku mbala ye ekisaanidde okubumba engeri gye mmusembereramu kaakano? Luther teyafaayo ku kusaba ng’okwolesa eby’eddiini. Yafaayo ku kusaba ng’emboozi entuufu wakati w’omuntu ddala ne Katonda omulamu.

Luther era yasabanga n’obukambwe obw’amaanyi ng’alwanyisa obubi obw’omwoyo, ekyewuunyisanga oluusi abantu ab’omu kiseera kye. Yategeera okusaba ng’olutalo, si mu kifaananyi bufaananyi — Okuddaabiriza kwennyini, mu kutegeera kwe, kwali lutalo lwa mwoyo olulwanirwa mu bifo ebya waggulu nga bwe lwali mu nkiiko z’ekkanisa. Yeesigama ku Abaefeso 6:18 — “nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera” — si ng’ekigambo eky’eddiini eky’okuzzaamu amaanyi obuzzi, wabula ng’ekiragiro ky’olutalo okuva eri omukulu w’eggye lya Mukama. Oluyimba lwe olw’ettutumu “Katonda Waffe Kigo Kya Maanyi” lwali kusaba nga bwe lwali okulangirira enjigiriza: okulangirira nti olutalo lwa Katonda, nti ebyokulwanyisa by’Obwakabaka si bya mubiri wabula bya mwoyo, era nti okusaba kye kyali ekifo ekisooka mu lutalo olwo.

Luther yabumbibwa nnyo Zabbuli ng’essomero ly’okusaba. Yazisangamu olukusa okuleeta mu maaso ga Katonda byonna omuntu by’ayitamu — si biseera bya kwebaza n’okusinza byokka, wabula n’eby’okwetaaga ennyo, okuggwamu essuubi, obusungu, n’okutabulwa. “Musabe n’obuvumu,” bwe yakubirizanga abayizi be. Katonda tanyiiga olw’obwetaavu bwo bw’oyogera butereevu. Anyiiga olw’okubuusabuusa kwo okukwekeddwa obanga ayagala okuwulira. 1 Peetero 5:7 — “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako” — kyali, eri Luther, bufunze bwa buli kimu: Katonda eyeeyolese mu Kristo afaayo, era eky’okukola eri Katonda afaayo kwe kumutwalira buli kimu.

Obulamu bwa Luther obw’okusaba tebwali kisenge kyawufu mu buweereza bwe. Bwe bwali embeera ebirala byonna mwe byakolerwanga. Ebigambo ebinene bye yabuulira mu kiseera ky’Okuddaabiriza byawandiikibwa omusajja ali ku maviivi.

Bayibuli ey’Olugirimaani yavvuunulwa omusajja eyasabiranga buli lupapula. Amabaluwa ag’obusumba gaawandiikibwa omusajja eyaleetanga buli gwe yawandiikira mu maaso g’entebe ya Katonda nga tannakwata kkalaamu. Okuddaabiriza okwakyusa ensi kwasitulibwa mu kusaba kw’omusajja eyakkiriza nti Katonda awulira, nti Katonda ayagala, era nti amaanyi ga Katonda gaali gasukkirira okumala buli kizibu Enjiri kye yandisisinkanye.

Essaala

Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, tukwebaza nti okuyita mu Kristo yekka tujja n’obuvumu eri entebe yo ng’abaana bo abaagalwa ennyo. Tuzuukusemu obuvumu bwa Luther — obuvumu nti owulira, nti osanyuka okuwulira, era nti oddamu okusaba okw’okukkiriza okuweebwayo mu linnya ly’Omwana wo. Amiina.

fields.body_html:

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Enjigiriza ya Wesley ku kusaba teyayawukana ku njigiriza ye ku kisa, era enjigiriza ye ku kisa ye yali esinga obugabi mu bakugu b’eby’eddiini Abapolotesitanti bonna ab’omu kiseera kye. Enjawulo eno yali nkulu nnyo. Enjigiriza y’okusaba ey’ebikolwa yazaalanga amalala (okusaba bwe kwalabikanga “nga kukola”) oba okuggwamu essuubi (bwe kwalabikanga nga tekukola). Enjigiriza ey’ekisa yazaala ekirala ddala: embeera ey’emikono emigolole, omukkiriza mw’asemberera Katonda si ng’omwegayirizi agezaako okumusanyusa, wabula ng’omwana afuna Kitaffe omugabi by’amaze okuteekateeka okumuwa.

Ebigambo ebyo ebibiri yabitwala nga bikulu ddala, ng’agamba nti “obutayosa” si kusavuwaza, wabula kunnyonnyola bulamu obujjudde okusaba buli mukkiriza bw’ayitibwamu — obulamu obutunuulira Katonda mu buli kye bukola. Omusuubuzi yali asobola okusabira ebitabo bye eby’ensimbi. Maama yali asobola okusabira ebitanda by’abaana be. Omupakasi yali asobola okusabira omulimu gwe.

Wesley yayagala ekkanisa ey’abantu abatasirisa ddala mboozi yaabwe ne Katonda, abawulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda ng’ennyimba ez’emabega mu buli ssaawa nga bazuukuse.

Ebigambo bye eby’ettutumu byakiraga: “Katonda takola kintu kyonna okuggyako ng’addamu okusaba.”

Yagolokokanga buli lunaku ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro — empisa gye yakuuma okutuusa mu myaka kinaana — n’awaayo essaawa bbiri ezisooka zonna eri okusaba n’okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa. Amaanyi ge ag’omubiri ag’ekitalo n’amagezi ge amatangaavu yagamba nti biva mu mpisa eno, kubanga ebiseera “ebimalibwa” mu kusaba tebifiirwa ku mulimu ogw’omugaso, wabula emmeeme mwe yejjulizibwa amaanyi ag’emirimu emirala gyonna. Teyagumiikirizanga nsonga nti abalina emirimu emingi tebalina biseera bya kusaba. “Tolina biseera bya kusaba?” bwe yaddangamu. “Kale tolina biseera bya kubeera mulamu bulungi.” Olunaku gye lukoma okujjula emirimu, n’obwetaavu bw’okulutandika mu kusaba gye bukoma okweyongera — kubanga ebyetaagisa ku lunaku bisinga nnyo obusobozi bw’omuntu, era ekyokka ekimala okubijjuliza kye kisa kya Katonda ekifunibwa mu kkubo ly’okusaba.

Wesley era yawagira nnyo okusaba okw’awamu — okw’abantu abakuŋŋaanye, so si okw’abantu kinnoomu bokka. Yali alabye mu nkuŋŋaana z’ebibiina by’Abametodisti amaanyi ag’ekitalo agajja ababiri oba abasatu bwe bakuŋŋaana mu linnya lya Kristo okusaba awamu, nga bakwata Yesu ku kigambo kye nga bwe kiri: “Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe” (Matayo 18:20). Olukuŋŋaana lw’ekibiina lwali ntegeka ya kkanisa ey’ekitalo kubanga lwagatta okuvunaanibwa, okuyigiriza n’okusaba mu nteekateeka emu — era okusaba tekwali kwolesa kulongooseddwa okw’omusumba eyawulibwa, wabula okwogera okw’amazima, oluusi okw’okuwankawanka, oluusi okw’amaziga, okw’abantu aba bulijjo nga baleeta obulamu bwabwe obwennyini mu maaso ga Katonda ow’amazima.

Okuzuukuka kw’Abawesley mu kyasa ekya kkumi na munaana, mu ndaba ya Wesley yennyini, kwali okusinga byonna kusaba okweyolekera mu kubuulira. Buli mutendera omukulu ogw’okuzuukuka gwasookebwangako ekiseera eky’okusaba. Enkuŋŋaana ez’ettutumu ez’“okutunula ekiro” — ez’okusaba ekiro kyonna, akabonero k’Abametodisti abaasooka — tezaali za kwongerezebwa ku kuzuukuka; ze zaali yingini yaakwo. Abakkolosaayi 4:2 kyannyonnyola Wesley kye yali anoonya: “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga”. Okunyiikirira — si kumanya Katonda bumanya, si kuddukira mu kusaba lumu na lumu ng’obuzibu buzze, wabula okwewaayo okutakoma, okugenderera, okw’olubeerera, okw’obulamu obutunudde ddala eri Katonda. Obutaddirira — okussaayo omwoyo ku Katonda by’akola mu nsi, nga weetegese okusabira embeera empya ezivaayo. Okwebaza — okusemberera Katonda si ng’agaba ebyetaago, wabula nga Kitaffe ow’okwagalwa, obwesigwa bwe obusaanira okwebazibwa obutakoma.

Obulamu bwa Wesley obw’okusaba bwatuuka ku lunaku lwe yafiirako. Ebigambo bye ebisembayo ebyawandiikibwa, bye yayogera ng’agalamidde ku kitanda ky’okufa nga yeetooloddwa mikwano gye, byali: “Ekisinga byonna obulungi kiri nti, Katonda ali naffe.” Kino tekyali kulangirira kwa njigiriza okwanoonyezebwa olw’omukolo ogwo. Kyali kivudde mu bulamu bwonna obw’okusaba — obw’okuzuula buli lunaku ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro nti Katonda, mu mazima, yali naye bulijjo. “Emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe” (Abafiripi 4:7) — emirembe egyo gyali gikuumye amagezi ge n’omutima gwe mu myaka kinaana mu musanvu egy’obulamu obw’ekitalo. Gyakikola okuyita mu mpisa n’essanyu ly’okusaba.

Essaala

Kitaffe, tuzzeemu empisa y’okusaba Wesley gye yakuuma — si bulombolombo obunnyogovu obw’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’eddiini, wabula empisa ey’ebbugumu ey’emmeeme emanyi essanyu ly’okusisinkana naawe. fields.title: Enkomerero: Okuyita Kukyaliwo
fields.body_html:
Otambudde mu bulamu bw’abantu kkumi. Abasajja kkumi abaazuula, buli omu mu ngeri ye, ekyama kye kimu ekitaliiko kiyinza kukidda mu bigere: nti Katonda w’ebintu byonna si katonda agumiikiriza obugumiikiriza okutaataaganyizibwa kw’abantu abamusaba nga tabafaako, wabula Kitaffe akutama okuva ku ntebe ye abaana be bwe basaba, anyeenya eggulu n’ensi okuddamu okwegayirira okujjudde okukkiriza, era asanyuka okukola okusinga byonna bye tusaba ne bye tulowooza.

Abasajja bano tebaali bantu basukkulumu. E. M. Bounds yali musumba w’Abametodisti mu byalo by’e Georgia.

George Müller yali muvubuka ow’e Prussia eyayonoona emyaka gye egisooka mu bukumpanya n’obutamiivu.

David Brainerd yali muvubuka mulwadde eyafa nga tannaweza myaka asatu. Rees Howells yali mutabani w’omusimi w’amanda Omuwelisi. Hudson Taylor yali mulenzi wa bulijjo ow’e Yorkshire, nga ku kisenge kya kitaawe kuliko maapu ya China. Ekyabafuula ab’ekitalo tekyali mbala yaabwe ey’obutonde, wabula Katonda gwe baggulirawo ekkubo okuyita mu kusaba okutakoma, okw’omutima gwonna, okujjudde okukkiriza.

Okuyita okwabasikiriza kukyali kuggule gy’oli. Entebe ya Katonda ey’ekisa eyogerwako mu bbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya teggyiddwawo. Omwoyo y’omu atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka akyabeera mu buli mukkiriza. Ebisuubizo bye bimu Müller bye yakuba mu kyapa n’abisaba, Taylor bye yeesiga n’abikolerako, Luther bye yabwatukira ku kituuti — bikyali mu Bayibuli yo leero. Ekibuuzo si kya kuba nti Katonda ayagala okuddamu okusaba. Ekibuuzo kiri nti: ggwe onoosaba?

Bino abalwanyi b’okusaba ab’omu byafaayo bye bandikugambye: Tandika. Tandika leero, tandika nga totuukiridde, tandika mu bunafu ne mu kutabulwa, era n’ebirowoozo ebiwugulana bwe kiba kyetaagisa — naye tandika. Teekawo essaawa ekuzuukusa nga bukyali okusinga bw’oyagala. Funa ekifo w’oyinza okubeera wekka nga toli mu bwangu. Bikkula Bayibuli yo, ebisuubizo byayo bibe amafuta g’okwegayirira kwo. Leeta emigugu gyo eri Katonda nga teweetonda era nga teweefuula mukkakkamu nga bw’otali. Leeta amannya g’abantu b’oyagala n’ab’ofuba okwagala. Leeta ebyetaago by’ekibuga kyo, eggwanga lyo, n’amawanga g’ensi agatannatuukibwako abatawulirangako linnya lya Yesu wadde omulundi gumu.

Era okuddibwamu bwe kutajja mangu — nga bwe kitera okubeera — jjukira Brainerd mu ddungu lya New Jersey, jjukira Müller mu maaso g’akabati akatalimu kintu ku ssaawa kkumi n’emu ez’oku makya, jjukira Hyde ng’avuunamye ekiro ekirala mu Punjab.

Jjukira nti Katonda alwawo si ye Katonda agaana. Akola mu kyama ky’ebiseera ekyo ekirikkulibwa lumu mu bujjuvu bw’emirembe n’emirembe. Okusaba kwo tekubuze. Wadde n’okumu. Kukuŋŋaanyizibwa mu maaso g’entebe ye, era mu kiseera ekituufu kujja kuddibwamu mu ngeri ezisinga byonna bye weeyaŋŋanga okusaba.

Beera mulwanyi w’okusaba. Ensi ekwetaaga ku maviivi go mu bwangu okusinga bw’ekwetaaga ng’oyimiridde. Eggulu lirindiridde. Entebe nzigule. Kitaffe awuliriza.

“Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo.”

— Yakobo 5:16

Era okuddibwamu bwe kutajja mangu — nga bwe kitera okubeera — jjukira Brainerd mu ddungu lya New Jersey, jjukira Müller mu maaso g’akabati akatalimu kintu ku ssaawa kkumi n’emu ez’oku makya, jjukira Hyde ng’avuunamye ekiro ekirala mu Punjab. Jjukira nti Katonda alwawo si ye Katonda agaana. Akola mu kyama ky’ebiseera ekyo ekirikkulibwa lumu mu bujjuvu bw’emirembe n’emirembe. Okusaba kwo tekubuze. Wadde n’okumu. fields.body_html:
Bino bye byawandiikibwa ebikulu ebikwata ku kusaba ebijuliziddwa mu kitabo kino kyonna. Ennyiriri zonna wano ziggiddwa mu Bayibuli mu Luganda Olwa Leero.
